*Due to Google policy, we can't provide a direct link, so here's the instructions below.

(🖥️ PC) Apollo: Search Google for "ClassicOldSong Apollo release" and download from the link that appears (see 04:54)
(📱 Galaxy Tab) Artemis: Search Google for "ClassicOldSong moonlight-android release" and download from the link that appears (see 06:05)

🚨If Artemis isn't installing properly on your tablet, try opening the Play Store ➜ Click on your profile in the top right corner ➜ Play Protect ➜ Settings icon in the top right corner ➜ Temporarily disable "Scan apps with Play Protect" and try installing!

2. For iPad (Sunshine, Moonlight)

(🖥️ PC) ☀️ Sunshine: Search for "LizardByte Sunshine release" on Google.
➜ Click the "Releases · LizardByte/Sunshine" page.
➜ Scroll down to find the version marked "Latest" (download from "Latest", not "Pre-release").
➜ Open the "Assets" toggle. ⇒ Click "Show all assets" at the bottom to view all files. ⇒ Download "Sunshine-Windows-AMD64-installer.exe".

(📱 iPad) 🌙 Moonlight: Search for and download from the App Store.

3. Apollo, introduced in the video, is a program that adds features to "Sunshine."

Therefore, interconnections like Apollo + Moonlight, Sunshine + Artemis, etc. are currently possible!
However, the Apollo developer has stated that compatibility will not be possible in the future. For stable use, use the combinations introduced in the video.
